title: Big
tagline: Grown-up food for a kid at heart.
about: A 12-year-old wishes to be big and wakes up as a grown man working at a toy company.
cue: Serve the snacks when Josh eats baby corn like a tiny corn cob at the company party.
faces: SUPPER, SWEETS AND THE SODA FOUNTAIN
Mr. MacMillan and our new V.P. of Product Development, four hands on one keyboard.
Thank you all for a big year. Tonight, no meetings. Eat well, try something new, and have fun. That is an order.
Please, no toy pitches at the table.
Charred in butter with crushed red pepper, lime zest and salt.
Salmon roe, crème fraîche and chives on crisp water crackers.
Garlic and soy marinated skewers, warm peanut sauce.
Steamed bun, mustard, sauerkraut and onions stewed in tomato.
Twisted by hand, coarse salt, yellow mustard to dip.
Brown-butter chocolate chip, iced with piano keys, cut at the table.
Spun to order, pink or blue, just like Sea Point Park.
Syrup, cold milk and seltzer, stirred until the foam rises.
Ginger ale, grenadine and a maraschino cherry.
Squeezed this afternoon, plenty of ice.

    StartersGriddled baby cornCharred in butter with crushed red pepper, lime zest and salt.Best eaten like corn on the cob.How to make it400g baby corn30g butter1 tsp chilli flakes2 limes, zested, then cut into wedges1 pinch saltBlanch the baby corn in salted boiling water, then drain well.Char on a hot griddle with the butter.Sprinkle with chilli flakes, lime zest and salt.Serve with lime wedges and eat it like a cob.Red caviar canapésSalmon roe, crème fraîche and chives on crisp water crackers.An acquired taste.How to make it20 water crackers200ml crème fraîche100g salmon roe1 bunch chives, snippedSpread each cracker with crème fraîche.Top with salmon roe and a few chives.Assemble just before serving so the crackers stay crisp.MainsCorner cart hot dogSteamed bun, mustard, sauerkraut and onions stewed in tomato.Have two. Nobody is counting.How to make it8 hot dog franks3 brown onions, one halved and two sliced2 tbsp oil2 tbsp tomato paste1 tbsp vinegar8 hot dog buns3 tbsp yellow mustard1 jar sauerkrautSimmer the franks in water with the halved onion, then griddle until blistered.Soften the sliced onions in oil, add the tomato paste and vinegar.Steam the buns.Fill with franks, mustard, sauerkraut and onions.SweetsThe giant cookieBrown-butter chocolate chip, iced with piano keys, cut at the table.Big enough for four hands.How to make it150g butter200g brown sugar1 egg250g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarb soda200g choc chips200g icing sugar2 tbsp waterBrown the butter and cool.Beat with the brown sugar and egg, then mix in the flour, bicarb and choc chips.Press into a pizza tray and bake at 180°C.Cool completely.Mix the icing sugar with the water, then pipe piano keys across the cookie.DrinksChocolate egg creamSyrup, cold milk and seltzer, stirred until the foam rises.No egg, no cream. Never was.How to make it8 tbsp chocolate syrup320ml cold milk600ml chilled soda waterAdd syrup and milk to each of 4 tall glasses.Pour in soda water hard from a height, stirring with a long spoon so a white foam head rises.Serve with a straw straight away.
